explanation: Keep FIFO values in one deque and possible maxima in nonincreasing order in another. An inserted value removes strictly smaller candidates; dequeuing removes its matching maximum candidate when necessary. Equal maxima are retained separately.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized enqueue, O(1) dequeue and maximum query.
spaceComplexity: O(n) stored queue and maximum-candidate entries.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithms. Uses the existing local native test-framework API. No upstream reference implementation was altered or translated.
